technical.lead: Anthropic opens Milan + Seoul offices; Glasswing hits 10,000+ critical findings
technical.body: Inside 48 hours of Thursday's Series H close, Anthropic appointed KiYoung Choi (ex-Snowflake Korea Country Manager) as Representative Director of Korea on May 26 per [Anthropic Korea](https://www.anthropic.com/news/kiyoung-choi-representative-director-anthropic-korea) and opened a Milan office on May 27 — its sixth European footprint after London, Dublin, Paris, Zurich, and Munich — under GDPR data residency per [Anthropic Milan](https://www.anthropic.com/news/milan-office-opening). The Project Glasswing first-update flowing through trade press the same week credited Claude Mythos Preview with 10,000+ high/critical findings across roughly 50 partners, 530 disclosures to maintainers, and 75 patches completed, per [Help Net Security](https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/05/26/anthropic-project-glasswing-update/) and [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/05/claude-mythos-ai-finds-10000-high.html).

technical.lead: SpaceX S-1 vs Musk: $37.5B disclosure gap on Anthropic Colossus deal
technical.body: SpaceX's May 20 S-1 collided publicly with Elon Musk's X-post characterization of the Anthropic compute arrangement on the day SpaceX confirmed a June 8 institutional roadshow at a $1.75T-$2T target and ~$75B raise. The prospectus describes a $1.25 billion monthly fee through May 2029 — implying a ~$45 billion three-year commitment — while Musk said the deal is a 180-day lease with 90-day mutual cancellation, capping obligation near ~$7.5 billion, per [The Next Web](https://thenextweb.com/news/musk-spacex-colossus-anthropic-180-day-lease) and [OpenTools](https://opentools.ai/news/musk-spacex-anthropic-180-day-lease). The asset is Memphis Colossus 1 — 220,000+ NVIDIA GPUs across 300+ MW — and SpaceX confirmed the SPCX ticker on Nasdaq with pricing June 11 and first trade June 12 per [TechStackIPO](https://www.techstackipo.com/ipo/spacex).

technical.lead: Figure AI BotQ scales Figure 03 to 1 robot/hour; 350+ shipped at 80% yield
technical.body: Figure AI on Wednesday May 27 disclosed that its BotQ manufacturing facility scaled Figure 03 production from one robot per day to one robot per hour over the prior 120 days — a 24x throughput improvement — pushing total shipments past 350 units across more than 10 product variants, with 55 robots planned for the week and over 9,000 actuators produced, per [Robotics and Automation News](https://roboticsandautomationnews.com/2026/05/27/figure-ramps-humanoid-robot-manufacturing-at-unprecedented-speed/101954/) and [Humanoids Daily](https://www.humanoidsdaily.com/news/figure-claims-production-milestone-as-botq-ramps-up-figure-03-manufacturing). The ramp leans on 150+ workstations distributed across dedicated assembly lines, custom manufacturing software, and tightened supplier quality controls that pushed first-pass yields above 80%, per [Interesting Engineering](https://interestingengineering.com/ai-robotics/figure-humanoid-robot-production-scale-up).

technical.lead: Bay Area June-July calendar: Snowflake, Build, WWDC, Databricks, AI Engineer
technical.body: The Bay Area conference wave packs into a five-week window starting Monday. Snowflake Summit 26 runs Moscone Center June 1-4 with a Monday 5:00 PM PT opening keynote pairing Snowflake CEO Sridhar Ramaswamy with Anthropic President Daniela Amodei, registration closing May 31 at $2,295, per [Snowflake Summit 26](https://www.snowflake.com/en/summit/). Microsoft Build 2026 follows Fort Mason San Francisco June 2-3 per [Microsoft Build](https://build.microsoft.com/en-US/home); Apple WWDC26 runs June 8-12 with the keynote Monday at 10:00 AM PT and an Apple Park developer event opened via lottery per [Apple Developer](https://developer.apple.com/wwdc26/); Databricks Data + AI Summit runs June 15-18 across Moscone with 800+ sessions per [Databricks](https://www.databricks.com/dataaisummit); AI Engineer World's Fair caps the wave Moscone West June 29-July 2 with 250+ speakers across 20+ tracks and 6,000+ stated attendance, hotel group rates expiring June 6 per [AI Engineer World's Fair](https://www.ai.engineer/worldsfair/2026).

technical.lead: wolfSSL CVE-2026-5194 cert-forgery flaw (CVSS 9.1) sits in ~5B IoT devices
technical.body: Among the Project Glasswing findings disclosed this week, a wolfSSL certificate-forgery vulnerability tracked as CVE-2026-5194 with a CVSS 9.1 base score reaches roughly five billion IoT, automotive, and industrial-control devices that embed the wolfSSL TLS library, per [Help Net Security](https://www.helpnetsecurity.com/2026/05/26/anthropic-project-glasswing-update/) and [The Hacker News](https://thehackernews.com/2026/05/claude-mythos-ai-finds-10000-high.html). The flaw is one specific named CVE inside the broader 530 high/critical disclosures and 75 completed patches that the Claude Mythos Preview cohort surfaced across roughly 50 partner organizations during the program's first reporting cycle.
